# betterado_serviceendpoint_permissions (Resource)

Manages service endpoint ACL permissions in Azure DevOps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betterado_project" "example" {
  name               = "Example Project"
  description        = "Managed by Terraform"
  visibility         = "private"
  version_control    = "Git"
  work_item_template = "Agile"
}

data "betterado_group" "example" {
  project_id = betterado_project.example.id
  name       = "[Example Project]\\Readers"
}

resource "betterado_serviceendpoint_permissions" "example" {
  project_id = betterado_project.example.id
  principal  = data.betterado_group.example.descriptor
  replace    = false

  permissions = {
    Use          = "allow"
    Administer   = "deny"
    Create       = "deny"
    ViewEndpoint = "allow"
    ViewAuthorization = "allow"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permissions` (Map of String)
- `principal` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `replace` (Boolean)
- `serviceendpoint_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
